title: Nikola Tesla
examples: What was the main difference between Tesla's electricity and Edison's?
Can you tell me about one of Tesla's other inventions?
How did the rivalry between Tesla and Edison affect technology?

explain.say: Today we are learning about the great inventor Nikola Tesla. He made many important contributions to science. We will look at his ideas about electricity.
Tesla championed the idea of alternating current. This type of current changes its direction regularly. It is very efficient for transmitting power over long distances.
Tesla also invented many things that changed daily life. Think about things like radio technology and remote controls. These were groundbreaking inventions for their time.
His rivalry with Thomas Edison was famous in history. Edison favoured direct current, but Tesla proved AC was superior for power grids.

draw.text: Tesla vs. Edison: AC vs DC

explain.say: In our everyday life, we use alternating current constantly. When you plug something into a wall socket, you are using AC power. This allows electricity to reach your home easily.
A common mistake is confusing AC and DC entirely. Remember that AC changes direction, while DC flows in one way only. Think of it like a river versus a tide.

draw.text: AC changes direction; DC is steady.

faq.q: What is the main difference between AC and DC?
faq.a: Direct current, or DC, flows in only one direction. Alternating current, or AC, periodically reverses its direction.
asks: What is the flow difference between AC and DC?

faq.q: Why was AC better for long distances?
faq.a: AC voltage can be easily stepped up and down using transformers. This makes sending power over long wires much more efficient.
asks: What makes AC good for power grids?

faq.q: Who was Thomas Edison, and what was his view on electricity?
faq.a: Edison was a famous inventor who strongly promoted the use of direct current systems. He was a major figure in early electrification.
asks: What did Edison use for electricity?
Tell me about Edison's electricity ideas.

faq.a: Tesla was heavily involved in the development of radio technology. His work was foundational to modern wireless communication systems.
asks: Was Tesla involved with radio waves?
What did Tesla contribute to radio?

faq.q: Did Tesla and Edison actually fight?
faq.a: Their professional disagreement over the best type of current was very public. It was a major technological battle of the late nineteenth century.
asks: Was there a rivalry between them?

facts: AC power is excellent for transmitting electricity over long distances.
Tesla developed many key components for modern radio communication.
The debate between AC and DC was central to modern power systems.

quiz.say: If you are powering a city from a central plant, which current type is best?
quiz.why: AC can be easily stepped up using transformers for long-distance travel.

wrong.0: DC is harder to step up and down efficiently for long wires.
wrong.1: Low voltage systems are usually for small local circuits, not whole cities.
wrong.2: This is not a recognized type of electrical current.

quiz.say: What does the change in current direction suggest about AC?

options.show: It only flows in one direction.
options.say: It only flows in one direction.

options.show: It only flows when switched on.
options.say: It only flows when switched on.

quiz.why: The definition of alternating current is that it reverses its flow regularly.

wrong.0: This describes direct current, not alternating current.
wrong.2: If it stayed constant, it would be direct current.
wrong.3: The flow pattern itself is what changes, not just the power supply.

quiz.say: Tesla's work was crucial for which modern technology?
quiz.why: Tesla's pioneering work laid the groundwork for how we send signals wirelessly today.

wrong.0: While important, this was not his primary breakthrough area.
wrong.1: These engines use fuel, not the electrical concepts Tesla focused on.
wrong.3: Steam power was a much earlier technology.
